contentBlocks.body: WHERE filters individual orders before grouping. HAVING filters the completed customer groups after SUM is available. This separation prevents cancelled orders from increasing paid revenue and lets the final threshold apply to the total rather than to each individual order. The boundary case includes a customer reaching exactly one thousand cents.
